verses.1: The priests shall not have any share or inheritance with Israel. It shall be a gift from the Lord, and they shall eat it as a portion of their inheritance.
verses.2: And he shall not have a share among his brothers. Jehovah will be his share, as He has spoken.
verses.3: And this shall be the judgment of the priests from among the people, regarding those who offer sacrifices. If there is any defect or flaw in the sacrifice, then the priest shall give to him the branches, the entrails, and the liver as compensation.
verses.4: At the beginning of your days, you will be blessed and honored. At the beginning of your years, you will be given wealth.
verses.5: For in him did Jehovah your God choose from all your tribes to stand and serve in the name of Jehovah. He and his descendants will do so forever.
verses.6: And when the Levite comes from one of your gates, from all of Israel, where he lives, and he goes with all his heart to the place that Jehovah has chosen.
verses.7: And let her be called by the name of Jehovah, her God, just like all her brothers who stand there before Jehovah.
verses.8: They will eat each other alone, after selling them on the market.
verses.9: For you are coming to the land that Jehovah your God gives you. You shall not learn to do what those nations do.
verses.10: There will not be found in you any son or daughter who is beautiful, with shining ornaments and decorations.
verses.11: And the friend asks his friend, and the mourner seeks to know, and he prays to the dead.
verses.12: For the sins of these people are terrible. Because of these sins, your God will remove them from before you.
verses.13: May you be pure in the presence of Jehovah, your God.
verses.14: For these nations, whom you are about to acquire, they will only listen to lies and illusions. But Jehovah your God has not given you such power.
verses.15: A prophet will come from among your brothers, just as I have come from among yours. He will be like me. Then you shall listen to him, O LORD your God.
verses.16: For all that you have asked of Jehovah your God during the assembly, I will not listen to His voice anymore. I will never see that great fire again. I will not believe in it anymore either.
verses.17: And the LORD said to me, “They have done well for having spoken.”
verses.18: I will send them a prophet from among their own people, just like this. I will put my words in his mouth, and he will speak to them about everything I command him to say.
verses.19: And the man who does not listen to my words, which I speak in my name, I will seek out and remove from among them.
verses.20: But the prophet who speaks things in my name, things that I did not command him to speak about, and who speaks on behalf of other gods… after that prophet has died.
verses.21: And if you say in your heart, “How can I know what the Lord has not spoken?”
verses.22: That the prophet may speak in the name of Jehovah. But the words spoken by the prophet must not be carried out. The words that Jehovah has not spoken should not be fulfilled. The prophet’s words must not be obeyed.
